 SUIT FOR RECOVERY OF Rs.3,04,131/- (RUPEES THREE LAKHS FOUR THOUSAND & ONE HUNDRED  THIRTY ONE ONLY.)
 1.

The present suit for recovery has been filed by M/s ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar Page no. 1 of 5 plaintiff/bank through its authorized representative Sh. Pankaj Jain, for recovery of Rs.3,04,131/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Four Thousand and One Hundred Thirty One Only) against the defendant stating inter-alia that defendant approached the plaintiff bank for granting of personal loan in sum of Rs.3,00,000/-.

entities.text: ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The defendant executed credit facility application form for the said facility and several other documents in favour of plaintiff bank and agreed to abide by the terms and conditions of the same.

The plaintiff bank sanctioned and disbursed the loan amount of Icici Bank Ltd vs Brajendra Kumar on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154571029/
1 Rs.3,00,000/ to the defendant vide loan account no. LPNOD00036103754 with the plaintiff bank.
The said loan was disbursed to the defendant on 19.08.2017 after deducting the processing fee and other charges.

entities.text: Icici Bank Ltd vs Brajendra Kumar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The defendant agreed to repay the said loan in 48 equated monthly installments of Rs.8,489/- each with interest @ 15.49 % per annum as per the repayment schedule.

The defendant further agreed that in case, any installment is delayed, the defendant would pay a penal interest @
15.49% per annum as per the agreement entered between the parties on the outstanding equated monthly installments amount and the plaintiff bank would be entitled to recall the entire loan and take further steps for recovery and enforcement of security.
Defendant failed to regularly maintain the financial discipline and to repay the loan despite reminders of the plaintiff.

The defendant paid an amount of Rs.51,819/- M/s ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar Page no. 2 of 5 (06 equated monthly installments) and defaulted in repayment of Rs.58,447/- (07 equated monthly installments) and Rs.8,066/- towards late payment and cheque bouncing charges totalling to Rs.66,774/- besides future installments of Rs.2,96,818/- as on 08.10.2018.

entities.text: ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thereafter, a loan recall notice dated 16.08.2018 was sent to defendant but to no avail.

It is thus stated that as per the accounts maintained by the plaintiff bank, the defendant is liable to pay a sum of Rs.3,04,131/-
towards principal, interest, penal interest and other dues as on 08.10.2018.
Hence, the present suit for recovery of Rs.3,04,131/- along with interest @ 15.49 % per annum.
2. Suit was filed under the Commercial Courts Act duly supported by statement of truth.
3. Summons of suit were issued to the defendant.
However, defendant could not be served through ordinary process.
Thereafter, an application under order V rule 20 CPC was moved on behalf of plaintiff.
Vide order dated 27.04.2023, the said application was allowed and defendant was served by way of publication in newspaper 'Dainik Jagran' dated 17.05.2023.
However, neither defendant appeared nor any written statement was filed.
Vide order dated 10.07.2023, the defendant was proceeded ex-parte.

4. Vide order dated 20.02.2023, an application for substitution of Authorized Representative was allowed and Sh. Jitender Mehndiratta was allowed to be M/s ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar Page no. 3 of 5 substituted as Authorized Representative of the bank.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In support of the petition, affidavit in evidence of PW-1 AR Sh. Jitender Mehendiratta was filed.

In his testimony he proved following documents:-
(i)Ex.PW1/1 (OSR) is the Power of Attorney having been executed in my favour by the plaintiff company.
(ii)Ex.PW1/2 is Original Credit Facility application.
(iii)Ex.PW1/3 is Original Disbursal Memo.

(iv)Ex.PW1/4 is copy of loan recall notice and postal receipt marked as Mark X.
Icici Bank Ltd vs Brajendra Kumar on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154571029/
2 (v)Ex.PW1/5 is prepayment/foreclosure of account dated 08.10.2018.
(vi)Ex.PW1/6 is statement of account dated 08.10.2018.
(vii)Ex.PW1/7 is Certificate under Section 65-B of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.
(viii)Ex.PW1/8 is Certificate under Section 2A of the Banker Book Evidence Act, 1881.
6. Arguments on behalf of plaintiff were addressed by Ld. Counsel for plaintiff.
7.
The court has considered arguments addressed on behalf of plaintiff and has gone through the material and evidence available on record.

8. The plaintiff has categorically stated that the defendant approached the plaintiff bank for grant of M/s ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar Page no. 4 of 5 personal loan under the personal loan scheme.

entities.text: ICICI Bank Ltd Vs Brajendra Kumar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The plaintiff has also proved all the relevant documents including credit facility application form thereby making its case for recovery against the defendant.
The testimony of the plaintiff that the defendant has only made part payment and has failed to make the payment of Rs.3,04,131/- due to the plaintiff has remained unrebutted.
No reply to the loan recall notice, sent by the plaintiff, was given by the defendant.

9. Hence, suit of the plaintiff is decreed with cost for a sum of Rs.3,04,131/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Four Thousand and One Hundred Thirty One Only) with pendetelite and future interest @ 11% per annum.

The payment of any amount if made by the defendant after filing of the suit and before passing this judgment be adjusted towards the balance installments of loan if the payment is made prior to expiry of the initially agreed term (tenure) of loan and towards the principle outstanding amount on the date of payment, after expiry of the initially agreed term (tenure) of loan.
10. Decree sheet be drawn accordingly.
11. File be consigned to record room.
Announced in the open court on the 18th day of October, 2023 (Ajay Pandey) District Judge (Commercial Court-10) Central, Tis Hazari Courts,Delhi.
